item.title: Senator wants premier to revive Maine-NB leaders' summit - K100
item.description: A New Brunswick Senator wants Brian Gallant to restore the Maine-New Brunswick leaders’ summit. Percy Mockler says it should be done because of Donald Trump’s protectionism efforts. A spokesperson for the premier told CBC the idea is being considered.

item.title: Renowned Saint John developer Pat Rocca passes away - K100
item.description: A developer behind many notable Saint John venues has died. Pat Rocca passed away in the Bahamas Friday night. His efforts saw the creation of Market Square, McAllister Place, Brunswick Square, Saint John Regional Hospital and the Canada Games Aquatic Centre among others.

item.description: The owner of The Canterbury Lounge has pleaded not guilty to violating the city noise bylaw. Sam Mackay is alleged to have done it December 27th and January 14th, with another count on the way from an incident that was first against a bartender. A trial date will be set...

item.title: King Canna Medicinals reopens after police raid - K100
item.description: One of six Saint John marijuana dispensaries has reopened after the police raids. King Canna Medicinals is open again after police charged employees and owners of the shops with possession for the purpose of trafficking. The raids were done last Tuesday.

item.title: Province, Crown prosecutors reach tentative agreement - K100
item.description: The province and Crown prosecutors have reached a tentative collective agreement. Represented by the Professional Institute of the Public Service of Canada, the group includes 63 prosecutors and family counsel. Details are being kept under wraps pending ratification.
